composite.label: Composite
composite.description: Draws several models on top of each other.

condition.label: Condition
condition.description: Picks one of two models by a true/false property.

select.label: Select
select.description: Picks a model by the value of a property (cases with a fallback).

rangeDispatch.label: Range dispatch
rangeDispatch.description: Picks a model by a number property crossing thresholds.

special.label: Special
special.description: Draws a model the game renders itself (head, chest, banner …).

bundleSelectedItem.label: Bundle selected item
bundleSelectedItem.description: Draws the item selected in an open bundle.

condition.broken: The item is about to break.
condition.bundleHasSelectedItem: The bundle is open and shows a selected item.
condition.carried: The item is being carried between inventory slots.
condition.component: A data component predicate matches the item (from 1.21.5).
condition.customModelData: An entry of the flags list in the custom_model_data component.
condition.extendedView: The player holds Shift while the item is shown in a GUI.
condition.fishingRodCast: A fishing bobber is attached to this rod.
condition.hasComponent: The item has the given data component.
condition.keybindDown: The player holds down the given key.
condition.selected: The item is in the selected hotbar slot.
condition.usingItem: The player is using the item (drawing a bow, eating …).
condition.viewEntity: The entity holding the item is the player whose view is shown.

select.blockState: A property of the block_state component (e.g. facing).
select.chargeType: What a crossbow is loaded with: none, arrow or rocket.
select.component: The value of a data component (from 1.21.5).
select.contextDimension: The dimension of the entity holding the item.
select.contextEntityType: The type of the entity holding the item.
select.customModelData: An entry of the strings list in the custom_model_data component.
select.displayContext: Where the item is shown: GUI, hand, head, ground …
select.localTime: The client’s current date or time, formatted with a pattern.
select.mainHand: The main hand of the player: left or right.
select.trimMaterial: The material of the item’s armor trim.

rangeDispatch.bundleFullness: How full the bundle is (0 to 1).
rangeDispatch.compass: The angle towards a target, as a compass shows it.
rangeDispatch.cooldown: The remaining cooldown of the item (0 to 1).
rangeDispatch.crossbowPull: How far a crossbow is drawn.
rangeDispatch.customModelData: An entry of the floats list in the custom_model_data component.
rangeDispatch.time: The time of day, the moon phase or a random value.
rangeDispatch.useCycle: The ticks of use, repeating every period.
rangeDispatch.useDuration: How long the item has been used (or how long is left).

special.banner: A banner with the item’s patterns.
special.bell: The bell of a bell block (from 26.1).
special.chest: A chest with a texture of the chest atlas.
special.copperGolemStatue: A copper golem statue in a pose.
special.decoratedPot: A decorated pot with the item’s sherds.
special.endCube: The starfield of an end portal or gateway (from 26.1).
special.head: A mob head or skull.
special.playerHead: A player head with the skin of the item’s profile (from 1.21.6).
special.shield: A shield with the item’s banner patterns.
special.shulkerBox: A shulker box with a texture of the shulker atlas.

tints.customModelData: An entry of the colors list in the custom_model_data component.
tints.dye: The dyed_color component, or the default.
tints.firework: The average color of the firework explosion, or the default.
tints.grass: The grass color of a climate.
tints.mapColor: The map_color component, or the default.
tints.potion: The potion color, or the default.
tints.team: The team color of the holder, or the default.

params.model: Model path; @model is the item’s own model.
params.scale: Multiplies the property value before it is compared.
params.base: Model for the transforms, particle texture and GUI light; @model is the item’s own model.
params.value: The value to check (condition) or the color (constant tint).
params.ignoreDefault: Components with their default value count as missing.
params.keybind: Key id of the controls, e.g. key.use.
params.blockStateProperty: Name of the block state property.
params.pattern: Date and time pattern, e.g. MM for the month.
params.locale: Locale of the format, e.g. en_US.
params.timeZone: Time zone, e.g. Europe/Berlin (default: the client’s).
params.wobble: The value wobbles before it settles.
params.normalize: Use 0 to 1 instead of the raw number.
params.period: Length of one cycle in ticks.
params.remaining: Count the ticks left instead of the ticks elapsed.
params.attachment: Standing on the ground or hanging on a wall (from 26.1).
params.page1: Turn progress of the first page (0 to 1).
params.page2: Turn progress of the second page (0 to 1).
params.openness: How far the lid is open (0 to 1).
params.chestType: Single chest or the left or right half (from 26.1).
params.effect: End portal or end gateway look.
params.default: Color used when the item has none.
params.handAnimationOnSwap: Plays the first-person swap animation when the held item changes. Default: true.
params.oversizedInGui: The model may render beyond its inventory slot (from 1.21.6).
params.swapAnimationScale: Speed of the swap animation; larger is faster (from 1.21.11).

transformation.leftRotation: Left rotation (quaternion x, y, z, w)
transformation.rightRotation: Right rotation (quaternion x, y, z, w)

ui.title: Item model tree
ui.description: Decide which model the game shows and when: by display context, state, time, damage and more.
ui.createHelp: The tree replaces the item model ResourcepackBuilder generates for this item. It starts with the item’s own model.
ui.noFallback: No fallback: nothing is drawn when no case matches.
ui.transformationHelp: Moves, rotates and scales the node (from Minecraft 26.1).
ui.unknownType: The editor does not know this type. Edit it in the additional YAML.
ui.rootKeysHelp: Keys at the root of the item model definition.
